column3: note

AIGetPlayer: atol of the calling thread's context (0x0043caa0, -1 when null) plus one; untagged answers 0 (fixed r10). Round 11: the context is now the thread's own, set by the AI's launcher (0x0041cd00/0x0041ccb0), not a spawn-tree walk; a synchronous callee (0x0069dca0) has none; test ai_get_player_reads_the_threads_context_and_not_its_ancestry

AIStart(player, profile, difficulty): 1..16, exact case-sensitive profile match (the 0x00435030 fold writes a buffer the 0x00426ea0 lookup never reads; fixed, test ai_start_host_entry_matches_the_profile_name_case_sensitively), difficulty+1 in 1..3, then the core 0x00434ca0 (old AI destroyed first); refusals print and return
AIStart(player, profile): read; the 3-argument rules with difficulty 0 (constructor's seat default kept); not bound, no shipped site and no surface entry

AIStart(player): read; 1..16 then core with no name and difficulty 0, so the constructor 0x0041e100 seeds the seat's playerdata profile and difficulty (outside 1..3 -> 3); not bound, no shipped site and no surface entry

AIStop: 1..16 message, then [p*800+0x1034] with p 1-based (= the core's 0-based slot), virtual destroy and null; no AI is a no-op; out-of-range carries on off the table in the original, refused here (labelled)
Unit::AI: handle resolves, [obj+0x70] player and its AI [player+0x88] non-null, then NOT bit 0 of the squad flags (0x00443e30 by [obj+0x174] player/index); false otherwise

Settlement::EconomyScript: 0 unless the owner ([set+0x90]) has an AI, then 0x0041d2a0: that AI's own array [ai+0x70], zeroed when its thread no longer runs. FIXED round 11: the slot is per (AI, settlement) (AiPlayer::settlements), so a seat that retakes a settlement finds its own entry; test economy_script_slots_belong_to_the_settlements_current_owner
Settlement::TacticScript: as EconomyScript with [ai+0x80] (0x0041d410); per-AI slot fixed alike

Settlement::RunEconomyScript: on the owner's AI (0x0042616b): stop the live slot script, write the id even 0, spawn <name>.vs with the settlement only for non-zero, tagged with the seat; missing name or file starts nothing, no trap (r10 fixes); FIXED round 11: the slot is the owner AI's own (AiPlayer::settlements), no longer one per settlement recovered by ownership; owner without an AI is a null this in retail, nothing here
Settlement::RunTacticScript: 0x0041d480, as RunEconomyScript (per-AI slot fixed alike)

Settlement::GetEconomyScript: GetEconomyScript.vs resolved on seat idPlayer-1 (0x0043d030), not the caller's; result <0 or failed run -> 0, else &0xffff (fixed; test get_economy_script_searches_the_arguments_seat_and_masks_the_answer); a callee that traps traps the caller (shared run_script_now, labelled)
Settlement::GetTacticScript: as GetEconomyScript with GetTacticScript.vs (0x0043d820; fixed alike); same callee-trap gap

Hero::TSAdvHeroSkills: only the hero handle is tested (arrays passed as resolved); TSH_HeroSkills.vs on the hero's player ([[hero+0x70]+8] into 0x0043d030), run synchronously with (hero, arrays); a failed run prints and returns where run_script_now traps (labelled)

Hero::AIGetSkillToDevelop: both outs -1 before the receiver test; skills with byte 0..9 only, HeroSkill <name>.vs else HEROSKILL DEFAULT.VS on the hero's player, (hero, i, &points=cur, &weight=100); counted when run ok, weight>0 and goal>cur; rand(1,total) at [0x996ff4]+0x12a0 slot 0x14 only when total>0; first skill taking the draw below 1, goal capped 10

Settlement::TSRecruitArmy: invalid receiver prints and answers the minted empty list; TSH_RecruitArmy.vs on the settlement owner's player ([[set+0x90]+8]) with (set, class, num, list). FIXED round 11: a helper that traps, suspends or is missing (0x006a0360 non-zero, 'Error running script!') answers the list as it stands, the failure reported with the pass (run_script_or_report); test ts_recruiters_answer_what_they_have_when_the_helper_fails
Settlement::TSArenaRecruit: as TSRecruitArmy with TSH_ArenaRecruit.vs and (set, num, list); failed helper answers the list (fixed alike)
Settlement::TSTempleRecruit: as TSArenaRecruit with TSH_TempleRecruit.vs; failed helper answers the list (fixed alike)

Settlement::TSRecruitHero: answer starts as the invalid handle; invalid receiver answers it; TSH_HeroRecruit.vs on the owner's player with (set, &hero), the by-ref slot read back. FIXED round 11: a failed or missing helper answers whatever the slot holds by then, reported with the pass; test ts_recruiters_answer_what_they_have_when_the_helper_fails

RunAIHelper/4: thunk -> core 0x004d2ee0 on the global helper manager [0x996888]: file data/ai helpers/<f>.vs, signature check void + count equal + every parameter by-value str (fixed; test a_helper_whose_signature_does_not_fit_starts_nothing), spawn untagged with no parent (fixed; test a_helper_started_by_an_ai_script_belongs_to_no_player), idmap[name]=id overwriting; missing file silent; the 0..127 thread-id pool cap (0x0069f910) not modelled
RunAIHelper/2: thunk, count 0, then the /4 core rules; bound (fixed: was unregistered), no shipped site
RunAIHelper/3: thunk, count 1; bound (fixed), no shipped site
RunAIHelper/5: thunk, count 3; bound (fixed), no shipped site
RunAIHelper/6: thunk, count 4; bound (fixed), no shipped site
RunAIHelper/7: thunk, count 5; bound (fixed), no shipped site
RunAIHelper/8: thunk, count 6; bound (fixed), no shipped site
RunAIHelper/9: thunk, count 7; bound (fixed), no shipped site

IsAIHelperRunning: map find (0x004d1cd0); the entry leaves when the thread ends (0x0069f7a0 -> hook 0x004d2160), so a finished helper answers false at once: table AND alive here (fixed; test the_helper_table_is_reaped_when_a_helper_ends); a self-stopped helper's step remainder not reproduced

StopAIHelper: 0x004d32e0 find; miss does nothing; hit stops with notify (0x0069fee0,1) and the hook erases; units' commands untouched; self-stop is a deferred flag in retail, immediate here (labelled, no shipped site)

GAIKA::Eval/6: viewer = player-1, negative -> every squad category 1 (fixed); category 0x0044e250 from the viewer's row (one-sided truce = ally, fixed); presence 0x0044e1f0 refined for enemies by 0x0044eb80 (difficulty sight table 0x0081a794, undrained order leaving->staying; fixed); accumulator 0x00427e90 skips messenger squads and fills enemy_hidden from hidden unheld front members (fixed); node settlement sentry strength [+0xf8] as staying (fixed); walks the modelled node deque in filing order (fixed: the squad table filtered by its fields); tests gaika_eval_adds_the_settlement_skips_messengers_and_sees_as_the_ai_sees and the census test; gaps: the remembered-enemy tail ([ai+0x40]/[ai+0x30], AI-record design) and squad_presence for a squad with no order and no DestGAIKA (roster design)
GAIKA::Eval/3: as /6 with gate sides & category and a plain add (fixed alike); walks the modelled node deque (fixed); same two gaps
GAIKA::Eval/2: as /3 with gate category 1, the own total (fixed alike); walks the modelled node deque (fixed); no memory tail; squad_presence gap
GAIKA::Eval/1: read; presence only, viewer -1 so every squad is category 1; not bound, no shipped site
Squad::Eval: [squad+0x1c] through 0x00443e30 with no squad test (a handle naming none answers 0 here where retail reads through null); the field is written by revalue_squads (sim/squad.hpp)

SquadList::Eval: 0 for a list not in the pool (0x0043ed70) or at EOL (0x00420170); else 0x0042a450 counts every entry but reads the cursor entry each time: size x strength of SL.Cur (fixed: was the squad form's answer; test squad_list_eval_is_the_size_times_the_cursor_squads_strength)
IsWaterLsa: area record type word == 1; id unchecked there, an id past the table answers false here as record 0 does
ShipNeeds: 0x0043ef00(player-1, lsa), the need word at +0x14+4(p-1); players outside 1..16 answer 0 (original reads a neighbouring word; no shipped caller passes one)
IncShipNeeds: +1 on the word at +0x10+4p, raw player, the same word ShipNeeds reads; players outside 1..16 refused
ClrShipNeeds: zeroes the same word; players outside 1..16 refused

Ships: reads the kept count at +0x54+4(p-1) (raised 0x0041f310, lowered 0x0041eee0 under asymmetric gates, holder-chain area for a held ship, two unnamed exclusion flags); engine answers a census of living ships by position (design, sim/ai.hpp)

CheckLsaPath -> 0x00441fe0 -> 0x00441b70 read whole (BFS, type test, shipless-sea bump, walk-back count); boardunit ship counts only with the empty order and (-1,-1) (0x00441730, fixed: any boarding ship counted); gaps: advance clause's enemy census (slot grid, sim/gaika.hpp) and the shipless test reads the census, not the kept +0x54 count

PrepareAiTransportShip: route search now passes the caller's order and point (0x00442010, fixed: it used the empty order), element 1 of a length-3 route, 0x00441730, 0x005c7dd0 writes order/point; same gaps as CheckLsaPath plus ship scan order (world by id, not the area list)

FindTeleport: whole body read; computer player skips a teleport whose node it has not explored (0x0041cb80, fixed: gate was absent); node of the teleport's position (0x0044e650); only gap is 0x0041cb80's two session overrides, unreproduced as at GAIKA::Explored
SPFFindAreas_Quant: 0x00411af0 slice of the smart-pathfinder build; engine answers false (no builder: movement pathfinder is this engine's own design, script never started here)
SPFCalcConnectHighRes_Quant: one connect row (0x00415880), answers counter <= last; engine false, same design
SPFIncreaseConnect_Quant: 0x004159b0 slice; engine false, same design
SPFInitData: 0x00416520 stage; engine no-op, same design
SPFInitDirectionData: 0x0040db30 stage; engine no-op, same design
SPFInitPointToAreaData: 0x00411c00 stage; engine no-op, same design
SPFInitConnectData: sets the connect pass's range on the builder; engine no-op, same design
SPFIncreaseConnect: 0x00415e30 then [builder+0x2c]=0; engine no-op, same design
SPFDone: destroys the live structure, installs the built one, frees the builder; engine no-op, same design
GAIKA::LSA: 0x0043cb00, node 0 -> 0, else the node record's 16-bit area (+0x10) by bare index; an id past the table answers 0 here (the areas are this engine's partition, sim/lsa.hpp)
LSA(x, y): 0x0043cb30, the area of the node at the point (0x0044e3f0); bound (fixed: was unregistered), no shipped site; point-to-node is GaikaTable::at, the slot-grid approximation (design)
LSA(pt): as LSA(x, y); bound (fixed), no shipped site; same slot-grid approximation

Obj::LSA: 0x0043cb70, node at the object's raw position (vtbl+0x3c; a held unit is no node, area 0), no handle test; served by the member LSA/0 by receiver type (fixed), no shipped site; same approximation
LSA(): a no-argument debugging command calling builders 0x0044e050 and 0x00450a50, answering nothing; not bound, no shipped site
GetGAIKA(Obj): 0x0044e650, null handle -> 0, raw position, posRH when x<0, negative -> 0; node from the slot grid approximated by GaikaTable::at (design)
GetGAIKA(point) / point::GetGAIKA: 0x0044e3f0, 0 with no node vector, &0xffff; slot grid approximated (design)
GetGAIKA(x, y): the point body with two ints; bound (fixed; test gaika_entry_points_read_the_table_the_way_the_scripts_do), no shipped site; slot grid approximated
Settlement::GetGaika: invalid handle -> 0, else the per-settlement node table by the settlement index (0x0044e9e0)
GAIKA::Center: node record +8/+0xc by bare index, (0,0) only without a node vector; node 0 and unknown ids answer (0,0) here

rect::Center: ((l+r)/2, (t+b)/2) truncating; shares Center/0 and is now answered for a rect receiver (fixed: was unbound; test gaika_entry_points_read_the_table_the_way_the_scripts_do), no shipped site

GAIKA::GetPriority: player-1 <16 with an AI ([rec+0x88]), (short)g != 0, g&0xffff inside the slot map, slot != 0 -> record +0x10; every miss 0 (laika_of; a player <=1 below the table is read as no AI)
GAIKA::Prioritized: laika_of then byte +2 bit 0x01
GAIKA::NoAttack: laika_of then byte +2 bit 0x10
GAIKA::NoRecruit: laika_of then byte +2 bit 0x08
GAIKA::GetControlFlag: laika_of then byte +2 bit 0x20
GAIKA::SetControlFlag: laika_of then set or clear 0x20 by the bool argument

GAIKA::LastSeen: laika_of then record +0xc; read matches, but the field is stamped by AiSystem::advance from exploration (labelled reading) where the original stamps it when sight is lost (per-player visibility sweep not modelled, design)

GAIKA::Explored: laika_of then 0x0041cb80: two session overrides (exploration setting in single player, reveal-all) answer true, else byte +2 bit 0x02; overrides not modelled and the bit is set from the exploration map (labelled reading of the unrecovered sweep)
GAIKA::Revealed: laika_of then 0x0041cbd0: with fog of war on, bit 0x04, else Explored; the bit needs current per-player sight, which is not kept, so it reads false (design)

GAIKA::SetPriority: the player's AI, slot = map[g] (0 past the map) into 0x0041cf00: slot 0 or unchanged value does nothing; else write, set Prioritized, stable adjacent swaps up to slot 1 or down, map repaired (GaikaView::set_priority)
LAIKA(player, i): player-1 <16 with an AI, i&0xffff below the record count -> that rank slot's node id (+0), else 0

GAIKA::GetStrat: GetGAIKAStrat.vs on seat idPlayer-1 via 0x0043d030 (a seat >=16 still runs the plain file; fixed), (g, idPlayer), negative or failed -> 0, else &0xffff (fixed; test get_strat_masks_to_sixteen_bits_and_runs_for_any_seat); a callee trap traps the caller (run_script_now, labelled)

GAIKA::CalcPriority: CalcGAIKAPriority.vs on seat idPlayer-1, (idPlayer, g), negative or failed -> 0, full 32 bits; out-of-range seat runs the plain file (fixed; test calc_priority_marshals_the_player_first); callee-trap gap

GAIKA::StratRunning: the player's AI [p*800+0x1034] (none -> 0), then 0x0041d150: g==0 -> 0, slot = map[g] (0 past the map), the record's strat (+4) zeroed when thread 0x34+g no longer runs; per-record script here

GAIKA::RunStrat: 0x0041d1d0 on the player's AI (no null test in retail, nothing here): stop thread 0x34+g when strat != 0, write strat unconditionally, spawn <name>.vs (void, GAIKA gaika) tagged with the seat for non-zero; missing file starts nothing

GAIKA::Empty: true without a node vector or node; else [node+0x18] (the squad deque) empty -- the deque is modelled (SquadTable::filed_under); fixed: a squad only heading for the node made it non-empty in the original and did not here (test gaika_empty_is_true_until_a_squad_stands_in_the_node)
GAIKACount: the node vector's size including reserved node 0 (count+1 here), 0 without a vector

GAIKA::ControlledNeighbors: count of the node's neighbours (+0x1e/+0x20) whose settlement (+0x14) owner [[set+0x90]+8] equals player-1; region neighbours skipped (neighbour list from this engine's partition)

GAIKA::CanExplore: false without the node; a neighbour explored for player-1, else a teleport in the world settlement vector whose position is in this node and whose far end's node is explored; Explored's session overrides (0x0041cb80) not modelled, and a teleport is always its own node here (partition)

GAIKA::GetDestPoint: (0,0) for no node, centre for a region node, else the settlement's position; BaseTownhall: nearest gate to the unit (initial best 200000), then 450 beyond it from the centre, bounds-tested inclusively, a refusal answering the gate (fixed: was the centre; test gaika_dest_point_aims_a_squad_at_the_ground_outside_the_nearest_gate); Outpost arm (0x00440060: 1300-unit offset tried at +-90 degrees against 0x004092b0) not reproduced, answers the settlement position
SS_STR: state <1 -> "SS_IDLE", else the constant table name (0x0043f1b0; "" past its end); names from the root profile's per-family table (sim/ai_profile.hpp numbering)

SetMAIKA: all three ids non-zero and distinct, then 0x0044fc60 records (src, dst, way-point) in a 512-capped list at the node manager +0x38 (also fed natively by 0x0041e6c0); the list is not kept here, so the call is accepted and dropped -- note corrected: its reader is GAIKA::Recruit's routing filter 0x0043eda0 (gated on the list being non-empty), which is skipped (routing-table design)

AreaAINoRecruit: area by name (0x004d9050; miss prints and does nothing), every node record whose centre is inside (rect inclusive, circle d2 <= r2), 0x0042b8d0 with {player-1, bits bool?8:0, mask bool?0:8}: sets or clears NoRecruit; node 0 skipped; the walk's early exit never fires (writer low half 0)
AreaAIMaxPriority: as NoRecruit with {player-1, bool?100:-1} into 0x0042b960: SetPriority 100, or 50 for a value below 1, through the re-sort (0x0041cf00)
AreaAISetAttackOptimism: as NoRecruit with {player-1, value} into 0x0042ba60 -> 0x0041d130: record +0x14 = value (Laika::optimism)

Eval: viewer player-1, flag mask -1, sweep 0x00423850 (map-clamped square, cells whole or cut by squared range inclusive; negative range visits nothing: fixed, test ai_eval_buckets_the_units_in_range_by_relation), visitor 0x004231f0 keeps units only, 0x004439d0 16-bit worth into 0x0044e250's bucket; outs always written; player <=0 reads a record before the table in retail, zeros here (labelled, no shipped site)

EnemyPlayersEval: outs zeroed; player-1 < 16 gate; per table player with category 4 (0x0044e250), 0x00443e70 on [record+0x8c] sums [squad+0x1c] over squads without flags 0x25; min/max written only when >0, mean total/count when count>0; returns total; player <=0 labelled as for Eval

GAIKA::ApproachingSquads: centre is the settlement's central building (0x005c1060) or [node+8], the same point here; walks the player's squads, skips GAIKAIn == node, heading 0x00444140 then DestGAIKA (squad_ai_dest); measures the FRONT member (0x00443df0) by its STORED position (vtbl+0x3c), strict < dist (fixed: read the leader, which AI squads lack, through the holder chain; test approaching_squads_sums_the_strength_on_its_way_to_the_node)

GAIKA::GetDistToPlayers: outs -1; every settlement whose central building is a BaseTownhall heir (0x0043ffc0, stronghold here), distance from its centre (0x005c1060) to [node+8] doubled when its node (0x0044e9e0) is missing or another LSA, into the 0x0044e250 bucket by strict <; player <=0 labelled

GAIKA::MilitaryPresence: squads with strength, category & 1 (own only: an ally is 2 -- fixed, was own+allies), negative viewer = everybody, viewer past 16 = nobody (fixed, was everybody), presence & 6 (in the node), not peaceful; then the node settlement 0x00420c00: a BaseTownhall with sentry strength [+0xf8] > 0 is a presence under category & 1 (fixed, was not asked); tests military_presence_wants_an_armed_squad_of_the_viewers_own_standing_in_this_node, military_presence_counts_the_viewers_own_manned_wall

GAIKA::MinNeed: GetArmyNeed.vs through 0x0043d120 (profile path 0x0043d030 = find_script; a failed run answers 0 -- run_script_now, shared gap) with bMin 1 and the player still 1-based; divisor [laika+0x14] when node low word != 0, player-1 < 16, an AI record and a view entry; need = max(1, need*100/optimism) in UNSIGNED arithmetic when need > 0 and optimism != 0 (fixed: a negative optimism left the raw need, retail floors it at 1; test min_need_and_max_need_run_get_army_need_and_scale_by_optimism)
GAIKA::MaxNeed: the MinNeed body with bMin 0 (same fix, same test)

Unit::BestTargetInGAIKA: wrapper -> 0x00431090; node 0x0044e650 (posRH); squads with strength, category & 4 off the receiver row (negative player = 1 = nothing), presence 0x0044e1f0(,,0) & 6 (0x0044eb80 cannot cross it); members offered by 0x004282c0, which STOPS the squad at the first missing/dead/held member (fixed: skipped and went on; test best_target_in_gaika_applies_the_squad_tests_one_at_a_time) and always returns 0; 0x00420c00 after the walk writes locals nothing reads; fallback: first settlement whose central building is a Catapult heir, enemy by the transposed bit, on the receiver node by stored position. Partial: the filter is CombatSystem::best_target_among, whose score is not the executable's, so 0x005db650's stop at a score under 50 and its 200-point nudges are not reproduced (combat design, shared with the family); the node is this engine's partition

Unit::BestMDPos: caster squad (0x00444190) GAIKAIn, (-1,-1) for every refusal; first loop collects squads with strength, category & 4, presence 0x0044e1f0(,,0) & 6 -- which refuses a PEACEFUL squad (fixed: wildlife was a candidate); second loop: front member exists, distance between caster and front posRH (vtbl+0xc8; fixed: was resolve_position, the holder record for a garrisoned unit) in [MinRange, MaxRange]; score from 0x00423a70, which COUNTS HEADS (inc) where Eval's 0x00423850 adds worth (fixed: summed object_power -- shipped MinEval 500 now means 500 units); protect subtracts own+ally; ranked = score + MaxRange - dist, strict > from MinEval-1, answered at >= 4; 0x00420c00 between the loops is overwritten before read; tests best_md_pos_bands_the_distance_and_floors_the_score, best_md_pos_measures_from_pos_rh_and_never_offers_a_peaceful_squad

Unit::BestProtPos: the BestMDPos first loop and distance (same two fixes, shared crowds_in_casters_node); after 0x00420c00 both winners reset to 0 and both bests to MinEval-1 (0x0043a63f..653); census 0x004228d0 (mask -1, the caster player) over 0x00423cd0 with visitor 0x00423280 = protect_census (own/ally/enemy heads, unshielded = bit 28 of [+0x194] assigned for own and added for allies, first own Sacrifice); a negative range visits nothing (fixed; test best_prot_pos_scores_the_size_of_the_engagement); refuse 2A < 3U, A or E under a tenth, E*A < MinEval; crowd preferred over sacrifice, each answered at >= 4

GAIKA::Recruit: AssUnderFireGaika read first ("/%s/Player%d/..."); gates avail < nMin, player-1 > 15, AI record, squad vector < 2; squads 1..n-1: flags 0x25 skip, 0x0043d1f0 (Eval 0 -> 0 without the script; EvalRecruit.vs; gDepend >= node count -> 0), budgets per depend via 0x0043d470 (CalcMaxTake.vs, take floored at 0 -- unobservable, labelled), take < worth refused, overflow and total as written; total-overflow < nMin gives up; sort 0x004326c0 descending by score (insertion sort below 33 entries, stable, = the index tie-break); re-run only if overflow, clearing depend within overneed; two send passes via 0x0043d380 (SendSquad.vs) with -4 marks and nMax/nMin stops; avail -= sent floored. Partial: the routing filter (0x0043eda0, gated on the MAIKA deque) is skipped because SetMAIKA keeps no table -- in retail SQUADMONITOR.VS calls SetMAIKA 3 times, so the filter is live there (note corrected: it was called faithful); routing-table design
